exchanges: what a week and its only wednesday
Hang in there, the weekend's on its way.
my son ferris lost another tooth, tooth fairy is going broke
Ha, the going rate these days is wild.
hes so proud of the gap tho
That gap-toothed grin is the best.
long day at halyard, the brewery got a massive order in
Busy is good for business, but I hope you got a break.
parents evening at greyfriars tonight for my son
Hope the teachers have good things to say.
went well, hes doing fine apparently
That's great to hear.
my wife seraphine is away at a conference so its just me and the boys
Holding down the fort solo, you've got this.
fish fingers for dinner three nights running lol
No judgment, fish fingers are a classic.
my stepson hates ballantyne, says the teachers are boring
Hopefully he finds a class that clicks for him.
trying to get him to give it a proper chance
That's a patient approach, it might help.
the saab wouldnt start this morning, had to get a jump off a stranger
Kind strangers are the best, hope it holds up.
probably time for a new battery
Sounds like a smart fix before it strands you again.
gideon next door has a dog called tolstoy, best name ever
That's a very distinguished name for a dog.
it keeps escaping into our garden
Sounds like it has decided your garden is better.
gideon reckons its a leonberger, its basically a small bear
That's a big fluffy friend to have wandering over.
the boys love it obviously
Of course, a giant dog is every kid's dream.
my son started cello lessons, the screeching is something
Everyone sounds rough at first, he'll get there.
my sciatica is flaring up from all the sitting at work
Ouch, a bit of stretching might take the edge off.
might book a massage if i can find time
You deserve it, especially this week.
grabbing takeaway from bramble tonight, best curry around
A good curry is the perfect end to a long day.
my wife is back friday thank god
Not long now, you're nearly there.
boys are watching cartoons and im just sitting here
Enjoy the quiet moment while it lasts.
my mate anouk switched to a motorola and wont stop going on about it
Ha, there's always someone who loves their new gadget.
anyway im off to bed
Night, hope the back feels better tomorrow.
